What is the LBMA London fix?
The LBMA (London Bullion Market Association) Gold and Silver fixes are the precious-metals
industry's benchmark settlement prices, set in London and used worldwide to price contracts,
ETFs and physical bullion. We chart the daily fix aggregated to a monthly close, back to 1968 —
a continuous, free history that is increasingly hard to find elsewhere.
